title: Optimize INSERT VALUES preallocation
constraints: Preserve INSERT VALUES, explicit column-list, ON CONFLICT, and RETURNING semantics
rationale: The INSERT VALUES path knows explicit column count, VALUES row count, and per-row expression count before building its intermediate vectors. Preallocating these containers reduces allocation growth during bulk INSERT VALUES execution.
steps: Preallocate explicit column mapping from the supplied column count
Reserve inserted_rows from VALUES row count when RETURNING is present
Preallocate raw_values from each VALUES row expression count
Verify multi-row insert, column-list insert, INSERT RETURNING, and mismatch errors
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in INSERT VALUES execution without changing inserted rows, constraints, indexes, or returned rows.
